name: A full A-to-high-B jump — clears the first two legs, not the third
summary: Extends chain coverage to the 3rd rung (mid-B->high-B), added after its step-4 review flagged that no chain persona yet exercised a merged answer being scored against each step's own distinct bands in a 3-leg run. Pairs a-to-low-b's 'ready-earned-upgrade' and low-b-to-mid-b's 'ready-earned-the-step' (both Ready) with mid-b-to-high-b's 'notyet-experienced-but-occasional' (gated Not yet — the new occasional_pilot_profile mechanism, unique to this rung). Tests that the chain correctly moves its focus to the newest/third leg once both earlier ones clear.
